title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Janumada Jodi
desc: A lovelorn village boy, Krishna, and a girl, Kanaka, cross all barriers of caste and tradition to unite in a meaningful manner.

title: Gaalipata
desc: Ganesh, Diganth and Kitty arrive in Mugilupete to stay at Diganth's grandfather's farmhouse. However, there Ganesh falls in love with Sowmya, a widow who stays with her in-laws, Kodandaram and Padma.

title: Nagadevathe
desc: Naganna, a worshipper of the snake goddess, vows celibacy in her honour, but is seduced by a dancer. When he dies from a snake bite, his brother starts to despise the deity.

title: Mandya
desc: Ganesh, also known as Eshwar, is compelled to move to the city after the bloodshed in his native town devastates him. When he returns years later, he adopts the task of educating people.
